Do you want the independence of a power wheelchair with the durability to handle everyday use? The FreeRider USA Apollo II Power Chair delivers just that. With front-wheel drive stability, high weight capacity, and long-range batteries, this power chair is built to keep you moving confidently indoors and outdoors. Heavy-Duty Performance The Apollo II Power Chair supports up to 470 lbs, making it one of the strongest in its class. Its front-wheel drive motor system provides excellent traction and stability on various surfaces, giving you the freedom to travel beyond smooth indoor flooring. Long-Range Travel With a driving range of up to 20 miles per charge, the Apollo II Power Chair lets you enjoy longer trips without worrying about frequent recharging. Perfect for full days of errands, doctor’s visits, or outdoor activities, this power chair ensures your mobility lasts as long as you do. Smooth Ride & Comfort Seating Equipped with full suspension and large flat-free tires, the Apollo II bariatric power chair absorbs bumps and provides a smooth ride even on uneven terrain. The padded captain’s seat with adjustable armrests ensures maximum comfort for all-day use. Maneuverability Indoors & Outdoors Thanks to its tight turning radius and front-wheel drive design, the Apollo II Power Chair balances indoor maneuverability with outdoor stability. It easily handles doorways, hallways, and sidewalks, making it a versatile mobility solution. Apollo II Power Chair Benefits & Features: Heavy-duty frame with 470 lbs capacity. Powerful front-wheel drive motor system. Extended 20-mile battery range. Full suspension and flat-free tires. Deluxe captain’s seat with adjustability. Tight turning radius for indoor navigation. Rugged build for outdoor paths. Reliable warranty coverage from FreeRider USA. FreeRider Apollo Chair II Specifications: Category Specification Weight Capacity 470 lbs Turning Radius 21 inches Top Speed 4 mph Ground Clearance 5 inches Safety Incline Rating 6 degrees Overall Length 47 inches Overall Width 26 inches Seat Type 21 inches Swivel, Reclining Captain Seat with Seatbelt Armrests Full-length, padded, width adjustable Tire Size (Front/Rear) 12.5 inches / 6 inches Solid Tires Chair Weight (w/o Battery) 233 lbs Battery Type 33Ah / 50Ah AGM Battery Off-board Charger 24V 5Amp, 100-240V Range (per charge) 12 miles with 33Ah battery, 20 miles with 50Ah batteries Drive System Front-Wheel Drive Handle Type Joystick Handle Color Red Note: Range varies with weight, terrain, temperature, battery condition etc. and is subject to manufacturing tolerances. Your battery will require a period of "breaking in" before they will reach their optimum capacity (up to 20 charge, discharge cycles can be expected) before full range is experienced. Book A Call Shipping information Please read through our order guide so you know what to expect once your order is placed. Order Confirmation:Once your order is placed you will receive a confirmation email with your order details. The confirmation email also means our system has processed your order and has pre-authorized your credit card. We will then submit your order to the transit team and/or warehouse manager to confirm that the product is ready for immediate packaging and shipping. If the product is out of stock or on backorder, we will reach out to you via telephone and/or e-mail. Shipment process:Shipping times vary between 1-3 business days on most orders and your item will be delivered in 3-10 business days after the order has been shipped.You will receive a shipping email with the tracking number(s) after the manufacturer initiates the shipping process with the carrier. If you do not receive the tracking information from our team within 8 days of placing your order, reach out to us at info@electricwheelchairsusa.com.Damages:Immediately upon delivery, carefully inspect the packaging of your item(s). If there is noticeable damage to the packaging make note of it when signing for delivery, or refuse delivery and it will be sent back to the manufacturer. If there is no or minimal damage to the packaging; but you discover damage to the item once you unpackage it, contact us immediately (within 48 hours) and send photos of the damage to info@electricwheelchairsusa.com. We will contact the manufacturer on your behalf to process any applicable claims. Low Price Guarantee We believe that you deserve the best prices online and we work hard to do ensure that. If you see another online website that has a lower price than us within 6 months of your date of purchase, let us know and we’ll be happy to refund the difference to your original payment method. Simply email us at info@electricwheelchairsusa.com your order number and purchase amount, a link to the exact product and brand from our website, and also the link from our competitors website so we can inspect the pricing. We will review your submission and apply a credit if it qualifies. Our Low Price Guarantee Has Some Limitations: The item must have already been purchased from our site prior to submitting a request. This does not include rebate programs or specific retailer programs such as buy three get one free type offers, sales not authorized by the manufacturer, or any similar promotions. The item will need to be in stock from the competitors site that you’re submitting the information from. The competitor must be an online store, they may not have a retail location, warehouse, showroom, or physical location. The website cannot be a wholesaler, liquidator, distributor, or auction website. Examples are eBay, Liquidation.com, Via Trading, overstock, etc. The competitor must also be someone who has been authorized by the supplier and/or manufacturer to resell the product. The Low Price Guarantee must also include the product listing price and the shipping total, but will exclude any sales tax that gets added at the final purchasing invoice. Financing Explore Our Financing Options at Electric Wheelchairs USA At Electric Wheelchairs USA, we're committed to making our products accessible and affordable for everyone. That's why we offer a range of financing options to suit different budgets and financial situations, including Klarna, Shop Pay (in partnership with Affirm), and our newest addition, PayTomorrow. Our Financing Providers: Klarna: A leading European bank, Klarna provides smooth and flexible payment solutions. With Klarna, you can select an installment plan that fits your financial situation. Note: Monthly financing through Klarna is issued by WebBank, member FDIC. For California residents, loans are made or arranged pursuant to a California Financing Law license. For more information, please visit our Klarna financing page. Shop Pay: In partnership with Affirm, Shop Pay offers you the option to pay in installments, making it easier to budget for your purchase. This option provides a transparent and straightforward way to spread your payments over time. PayTomorrow: A convenient financing option that offers straightforward pricing, quick application process, and automatic payments. PayTomorrow is designed to make financing easy and accessible, without affecting your credit score when you apply. For more information, please visit our PayTomorrow financing page. Laybuy: Laybuy offers interest-free installments so you can get what you want now and spread the cost over weekly payments. Enjoy a fast approval process, no hidden fees, and automatic weekly payments for a stress-free checkout experience. For more details, please visit our Laybuy financing page. How to Apply for Financing: Add to Your Cart: Select the product(s) you wish to purchase and add them to your cart. 2. Proceed to Checkout: After selecting your items, go to the checkout page. 3. Enter Your Shipping Details: Provide your shipping address. 4. Select a Financing Option: Choose between Klarna, PayTomorrow, or Shop Pay Installments for your financing. You will be redirected to the respective platform to complete your application. 5. Enjoy Your Purchase: Once your financing is approved, relax and anticipate the arrival of your mobility product. Financing Terms and Eligibility: The terms of financing, such as interest rates and repayment periods, will vary based on the chosen provider and your creditworthiness. Eligibility requirements may include age, residency, and credit history checks. Please review the specific criteria of each provider during the application process. For additional support or to explore our products, please visit our FAQ page or contact our customer service team. We're here to ensure you find the right mobility solution with a payment plan that suits your needs. Questions & Answers Have a Question? Ask a Question Cancel Can I buy a charger? Absolutely! If you have any other questions, or if you need help selecting a product that fits your needs, please give us a call at 800-682-9444. We are here 7 days a week from 8AM to 8PM EST.
